title: RANKX with ASC gives rank 1 to the lowest value
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( Player, "Rank", RANKX ( Player, Player[Score], Player[Score], ASC ) )

source.quote: Ranks in ascending order of expression. If value is equal to the lowest number in expression then RANKX returns 1.
The next rank value, after a tie, is the rank value of the tie plus the count of tied values.
source.supports: Skip is the default for ties

derivation: Player scores: Ann 90, Bob 80, Cho 80, Dee 70, Eve 70, Fay 50. Ascending: 50 is 1; the two 70s share 2; the next rank is 4 for the two 80s; 90 is 6.
